SCORE reuse: 20
JUSTIFICATION reuse: the delta removes the duplicate reader and delegates to reckon/crew/query.py:740 _mounted_projects, which wraps reckon/crew/routing.py mounted_repository_projects and flight.mounted_project_docs — an owner that already existed, now extended rather than forked, and no new definition is added.
FINDING reckon/crew/directory.py:245 non-blocking: calling the registry owner makes reckon/crew/routing.py's PlanVisibilityError reachable from the default board read, and neither production caller translates it — reckon/mcp_views.py:4141 catches only DirectoryError/RunQueryError and reckon/crew_run_commands.py:450 only DirectoryError — so an invalid mounts registry turns the workstation-scope board into an uncaught exception where the deleted helper degraded to listing no idle owners.
FINDING tests/test_the_board_extends_the_directory.py:121 non-blocking: the fixture writes only the flat registry shape, so the reuse repair has no regression guard — a future local reader that again knows only the flat shape passes this file, and a nested {"mounts": {...}} or unreadable registry is never exercised.
